summary.text: Jordan Bridges is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 33, listed with Logan County. His legislative page lists him as Assistant Majority Whip.

paragraphs.text: Bridges' page gives his birth date as March 28, 1988, and his birthplace as Logan, West Virginia, and lists Beth Haven and Southern Community College under education.
It lists his occupation as coal miner and names two children, Gracie and Jackson.
His committee assignments include Energy and Manufacturing, Energy and Public Works, and Environment, Infrastructure, and Technology.
